items.title: Show HN: Tachyon – Java MCP Server SDK
items.contentSnippet:
Expose Java methods as Streamable HTTP MCP Server. Compliant with latest+previous MCP specification with all MCP features: tools, resources, prompts, completions, extensions, including tasks and skills (SEP-2640). Runs on Netty - industry standard IO library. Supports DSL and declarative java annotations.

items.title: Show HN: Full-page screenshots with free annotation and PDF export
items.contentSnippet:
I built Fullpage Screenshot because I wanted to capture a whole webpage and mark it up without paying to unlock the editor. GoFullPage offers annotation through Premium; this extension includes crop, arrows, shapes, text, pen, and solid redaction for free. 
No accounts and nothing ever leaves your computer.
PS: The annotation editor is built with the open source Konva.js—shoutout to its maintainers.
